description.value: Gold & Jade Restaurant is a family-owned, Western-style Chinese restaurant in the heart of Princeton, BC, a common stop on the Similkameen cycling corridor. The restaurant accepts all Canadian credit cards and has an updated menu as of June 2025. Princeton sits at the confluence of the Similkameen and Tulameen rivers and is a key resupply point for cyclists on multi-day tours through the region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and confirms the business at 242 Bridge St., Princeton, BC with phone (250) 295-7644, matching OSM exactly. A menu update dated June 2025 confirms the restaurant is currently operating. No website content addresses bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities, so those fields remain null.
concerns: Website contains two conflicting hour listings (front page post vs. sidebar widget), suggesting some content may be stale, though the June 2025 menu update indicates the business itself is current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible restaurant in Princeton confirmed by a June 2025 menu update; a useful food stop for touring cyclists on the Similkameen route.

wow_evidence: family-owned, Western-style Chinese restaurant in the heart of Princeton
